steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each claim needs evidence, each offer needs terms, and each message needs a consent record.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Comparative claim with no evidence reference
findings.fix: Add the evidence or remove the claim

findings.title: Offer with no terms
findings.fix: Add the terms of the offer

findings.title: Message to a list with an unclear consent record

outcome.notChecked: Whether a claim is true; the law of each jurisdiction; whether a consent was valid.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 high, 1 medium).
[high] claim-best.md:12  Comparative claim with no evidence reference.
       Fix: Add the evidence or remove the claim.
[high] offer-terms.md:19  Offer with no terms.
       Fix: Add the terms of the offer.
[medium] list-unclear.md:26  Message to a list with an unclear consent record.
       Fix: Check the consent before sending.
Not checked: Whether a claim is true; the law of each jurisdiction; whether a consent was valid.
pros: Checks an absolute or comparative claim with no evidence reference; a price or offer with no terms; a message to a list with no consent record or an unclear consent scope; a channel with a known opt-out rule.
cons: Not checked: Whether a claim is true; the law of each jurisdiction; whether a consent was valid.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mkt-compliance-review skill on the records for this review.
